recommendedTextbook.title: Essential Commerce for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: O. A. Longe
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Foreign Trade and International Commercial Terms
subtopics: Concept of foreign (international) trade: Visible vs invisible exports and imports
Mercantile terms and incoterms: FOB (Free On Board), CIF (Cost, Insurance and Freight), Ex-works, COD
Documents in international commerce: Bill of lading, consular invoice, certificate of origin, letter of credit
objectives: Distinguish balance of trade from balance of payments
Interpret FOB and CIF price quotations in foreign exchange trade contracts
Trace the documentary credit procedure of opening an irrevocable Letter of Credit (LC) with commercial banks

topics.topic: Customs and Excise, Ports Administration in Nigeria
subtopics: Statutory functions of the Nigeria Customs Service (NCS): Tariff collection, anti-smuggling
Nigerian Ports Authority (NPA) and bonded terminal operations in Lagos ports (Apapa and Tin Can)
Bonded warehouses, customs duties (ad valorem vs specific duties), and import prohibition lists
objectives: Calculate ad valorem import duty on imported commercial cargo in Naira
Explain the economic rationale of bonded warehouses for dutiable goods
Analyze economic damages of smuggling and contraband entry on local Nigerian manufacturing

topics.topic: Insurance: Principles and Business Risk Management
subtopics: Meaning of insurance and difference between insurance and assurance
Basic principles: Insurable interest, utmost good faith (uberrimae fidei), indemnity, subrogation, proximate cause, contribution
Classes: Marine insurance (hull, cargo, freight), fire insurance, motor insurance, burglary, life assurance
objectives: Explain the principle of indemnity and why an insured cannot profit from a loss
Apply the principle of contribution to double insurance claims
Evaluate compulsory motor third-party insurance under Nigerian traffic laws

subtopics: Importance of warehousing to commerce (seasonal production balancing, security, quality maturation)
Types: Private, public, bonded, state/cooperative warehouses
Logistics and supply chain management: Cold chain storage for agricultural perishables
objectives: Identify 4 features of a modern commercial warehouse
Explain how cold chain warehouses prevent post-harvest tomato and fish rot in Nigeria
Examine location factors determining where to site a central distribution hub
